title: docs(pm-skills): adopt eight measured platform readings into the governed fact table, each paid in place
body:
Part of #18426 — the carrier of a seven-card batch, all landing rows in one governed file.

`Clause-②: no`

One file: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, held at **466 / 466** (headroom 0,
widest line 120 B). No ceiling was raised. Every adopted row is paid by a compression or a dedup **in the same
file**, listed beside the sentence it shortened. Rows :10–:12, :212 and :431 are untouched — verified by content,
and none of them appears in any hunk of the diff.

Each reading was adopted or rejected **on its own**, as the cards ask.

## Why the five rejections — the four axes

All five reject for **one** reason: the reading is **already in the fact table**, measured and phrased. That makes
this a single class, so the axes are argued once and the per-card evidence follows.

- **实际业务需求** — the need each card names is real, and it is already served. A seat asking 「who authors my
  REST writes」 lands on `:129` (「类只认每次写回读的 `user.login`/`user.type`」); a seat asking 「where is my PR in
  the queue」 lands on `:70`–`:73`, which carries the parent-tip chain recipe **and** a caution the card does not
  have (`:72`: the embedded parent is a presumed base, measured to reach `main` ten-plus minutes later). Adding a
  second row would not add a reader path; it would add a second place to disagree.
- **项目长远合理性** — a fact table with two rows for one fact is the workaround shape this repo refuses. When one
  copy is later corrected, the other stays, and the next seat reads whichever it reaches first. One row, one
  reader path.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — this is the axis that decides it. A duplicated row is a **lenient** surface: it lets a
  future edit narrow one copy while the other keeps the old claim, and nothing goes red. The strict form is one
  row, which the ratchet already prices. Note the direction of the rejection: none of the five loses a fact —
  each is being kept, in the line that already carries it.
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — at 466 / 466 every row is paid by deleting or compressing another. Paying real
  compression for a fact that is already written down spends the budget twice and shrinks the table's coverage by
  exactly the sentence that was compressed to make room.

Per-card evidence:

- **#18426 ②** — `:126` names both token classes (`claude[bot]` and the account), `:127` says the class is per
  Claude Code account and can flip mid-session, `:129` says the class is only known by reading back each write,
  `:132` says never assume `claude[bot]`. `:128` already lists two measured flips. The card's third measurement
  (`os-sam` vs `hotlong`) confirms a rule the table states; it does not change it.
- **#18426 ④** — `:375` records the `git push --delete` disconnect with the misleading tail, `:374` and `:376`
  record the consequence (probe branches accumulate), and `:430` records the second form, the proxy 403, with the
  same disposition and an explicit 「⛔ 不重试」.
- **#18426 ⑤** — `:250` is the reading: 「`comments` 计数会多读:实测 1 而列表与 timeline 双 0 ⇒ 线程空否读那两条,
  ⛔ 不读计数」. The cause is at `:164`–`:167`. ⚠️ Worth the seat's eye: the triage grading on #18426 asked
  specifically for this one to be written in, and it already was.
- **#18458** — `:70` gives the name form and says the embedded sha is the previous entry's tip; `:71` gives the
  walk and says lexical order is meaningless; `:73` says it is zero-quota and answers the position that the
  timeline cannot. `:61` keeps the positive-only caution the card asks to preserve.
- **#18467 (main)** — `:410`: 「issue 正文 `PATCH` 识别按整块:送全块或不送页脚都存回恰一条,已有页脚归一末尾不
  复制」 is the not-doubled half; `:357` is the blank-line re-anchor and the instruction to compare by first
  differing offset rather than by length. What was **missing** is the operating consequence, and that is the row
  adopted at `:357`.

## Measurements taken for this PR

- **#18498's restatement sweep.** The dispatch asks where else the `-z` advice is restated, so the same edit can
  ride the same PR. Measured repo-wide, exit code captured before any pipe: `git grep -F 'grep -z'` → **exit 1**,
  `git grep -F -- '-Pz'` → **exit 1**, `git grep -F '行向'` → **exit 1**. Lit control in the same batch:
  `git grep -F '拼接后'` → **exit 0**, hitting `platform-readings.md:290`, and `grep -c grep` on that file → 13.
  ⇒ **the `-z` advice is restated nowhere in this repo** — it lives in the dispatching seat's own prose, handed
  down per round. Nothing in SKILL.md or core-rules needed the co-edit, so nothing is reported for re-scoping.
  The row is placed under pit ⑥ (`:290`), which is where this repo's wrapped-phrase discipline actually lives.
- **#18446's second half is NOT line-neutral in `contract-review.md`.** That file is at 60 / 60. Its landing
  pre-check block `:40`–`:46` runs 99–120 B per line, and the cheapest adjacent merge inside it is **213 B** —
  no insertion fits without a raise. ⇒ per the dispatch's own instruction for that case, the row at `:85` carries
  the sequence: 「③ 在入队前末次状态写之后读」. `contract-review.md` is untouched, still 60 / 60.
- **#18446 is recorded in its generalised form**, per the card's own addendum: a label strip and a ready flip are
  both state writes. `:84` already recorded the ready-flip re-run with a different consequence (enqueue timing);
  the new row states the consequence for pre-check ③.
